summary: Comprehensive implementation plan for the AI-Powered Student Study, Revision, and Academic Schedule Manager (StudyScribe / SynapseAI). Details the Socratic AI Tutor with strict anti-cheating guardrails, personalized revision generator (flashcards, quizzes, summary notes), study session timers with break chimes, weekly goal visualizer, upcoming exam deadline countdowns, progress analytics, gamification (XP, streaks, milestone badges, friendly leaderboard), and student login/profile management.
